empty.title: No pinned conversations
empty.body: A pinned conversation appears here. Pin one from the sidebar's row menu, or press the add key once the panel has one.

menu.title: Panel menu
menu.layoutHint: Left and right change it; automatic follows the window
menu.removeHint: This unpins the conversation, here and in the sidebar
menu.approvalHint: Applies to every conversation, not just this cell

add.title: Add a conversation
add.empty: Nothing here can be added. Every conversation in this place is already pinned.
add.footer: Adding pins the conversation: it appears here and in the sidebar's pinned section.
